reconstruction_policy.E: Accepted nativeMoltenShield adds charge capped4; does not consume prepared stun.
reconstruction_policy.Q: Accepted cast/release does not charge; successful damage impact examines live owner charges once, consumes ready or adds one. E during flight can prepare stun. Dead/missing target no charge/consumption.
reconstruction_policy.W_R: Once per successful release, consume ready or add one. Same stun token applied to every living enemy hit; empty release consumes ready under current reconstructed policy.
reconstruction_policy.duration: Level1-5 1.25,6-10 1.5,11-18 1.75sec -> existing ceil30Hz conversion38/45/53ticks; champion tenacity applied once by grant_stun.
reconstruction_policy.death: Stored in Effects, currently cleared on death by common Effects reset. Native MarkerPersistsThroughDeath true does NOT prove charge/ready state should persist; current policy remains unqualified.
reconstruction_policy.unsupported: Spell shields/general immunity not implemented; Boss grant_stun explicitly policy-not-qualified, so no fabricated Vilemaw immunity.
